"...Looks like we've got no choice but to go on."
"............"

No matter what waits for us at the end...

..................

Next is..."{p}
rows.25:11b84:
"Um... {a}.
I don't remember anything from back then...
I didn't do something bad to you, did I...?"
Hosoda asked me apologetically.
He had become completely meek.
So meek I could hardly believe he was the same person who had attacked me earlier.
"......No, I'm fine. Please don't worry about it."
Seeing Hosoda so pale, curled up small and trembling, I couldn't bring myself to tell him the truth.
"...I see. Thank you."
Hosoda, too, seemed to sense, vaguely, that he had been violent with me.
Even so...
Is Hosoda really all right?
If it turns out he went and got himself possessed by a spirit again, there'll be nothing we can do.
What if he's only pretending to be meek and goes berserk on the way home?
Well, I don't think that will happen, but...{p}

Wait{f: a second|}.
